Setup · two codes in order

Use the existing tablet enrollment. Setup codes are available only if an administrator directs reconfiguration; do not rescan for a routine update.

Code 1 · Android enrollment

Open the installation page on a computer or second screen. On the fresh tablet’s Android welcome screen, tap the same spot six times to open its provisioning QR scanner. Connect Wi-Fi when prompted, scan Code 1, and stay online while TinyMDM installs Factory Commissioning.

Code 2 · app configuration
